user.title: Connect a water subscription
user.description: Enter your customer portal credentials and the contract number shown on your bill.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your water account
reauth_confirm.description: Enter valid credentials for the existing contract.

error.invalid_auth: The water portal rejected the credentials.
error.invalid_contract: Check the contract number and whether it belongs to this account.
error.cannot_connect: The portal is temporarily unreachable. Try again later.
error.unexpected_response: The portal returned an unexpected response when reading the contract. See the Home Assistant logs.
error.unexpected_login_response: The portal returned an unexpected login response. See the Home Assistant logs for the failed step.
error.mfa_required: This account requires a second authentication factor. Use the water portal to access your account.

abort.already_in_progress: This contract is already being configured.

init.title: Water alerts and costs
init.description: Enter 0 L to disable the consumption alert. The estimate covers variable costs including taxes. The initial rate applies from the selected date. To change the rate, choose a future date.

error.invalid_price: Enter a non-negative price with up to four decimal places.
error.retroactive_tariff: Choose a date from tomorrow onward to change a rate.
